div.div: Promotion 8, the Furniture Seasonal Promotion (PROMO-2026-008, 10%, 2026-09-01 to 2026-10-31), has the most promotion lines and the most discount dollars. Its dates straddle the two quarters under review. Its effect on Furniture prices in each quarter cannot yet be measured, because the invoice lines carry no invoice date or item group.
